full_name: City-Wide AI Engine for Multi-Camera ANPR, Trajectory Tracking and Urban Traffic Analytics
description: NetraPath transforms a city's existing CCTV/ANPR camera network from a collection of isolated detection points into a unified, privacy-aware urban mobility intelligence system. It links every plate detection across cameras into a continuous vehicle timeline, reconstructs the actual route driven on a GIS map, and converts the aggregated detection stream into macro traffic analytics — congestion heatmaps, origin-destination patterns, and speed estimates — all visible on a single web dashboard in real time.
core_requirements: High-accuracy ANPR and OCR engine (target >= 90% plate recognition on diverse test set)
Single-plate trajectory reconstruction across multiple cameras with GIS route visualisation
Macro-level traffic flow analytics, congestion heatmaps, and real-time blacklist alerting

layers.name: Edge / Ingestion
layers.responsibility: Read video, detect vehicles, run OCR, emit events

layers.name: Event Streaming
layers.technology: Apache Kafka (or MQTT for small scale)
layers.responsibility: Buffer and route detection events to backend services

layers.name: Backend Services
layers.responsibility: Store detections, reconstruct trajectories, run alerts

layers.name: Frontend / Dashboard
layers.responsibility: GIS map, search, heatmaps, alerts, analytics

architecture.pipeline_flow: Camera/Video -> Frame Extraction -> Vehicle Detection (YOLO) -> Plate Detection (YOLO) -> Image Enhancement (CLAHE, perspective) -> OCR + Confidence Score -> Temporal Fusion -> Plate Validation -> Kafka Event -> Backend API -> PostgreSQL/PostGIS -> Trajectory Engine -> GIS Dashboard -> Alert Engine -> Operator

dashboard_pages.name: Login
dashboard_pages.description: JWT login form; store token + role in Zustand; redirect by role.

dashboard_pages.name: Home / Overview
dashboard_pages.description: Stat tiles: vehicles today, active alerts, cameras online. Mini map. Quick links.

dashboard_pages.name: Plate Search (core)
dashboard_pages.description: Text input + date range -> GET /trajectory -> draw LineString on Leaflet map -> sighting list with thumbnails.

dashboard_pages.name: Live Alerts
dashboard_pages.description: WebSocket connection -> real-time alert cards -> click to open detail + map pin. Acknowledge / resolve buttons.

dashboard_pages.name: Watchlist Mgmt
dashboard_pages.description: Table of active watchlist entries. Add/deactivate form (role-gated).

dashboard_pages.name: Traffic Heatmap
dashboard_pages.description: Leaflet + heatmap.js layer. Time-window slider. Auto-refresh every 60 s. Camera-to-camera flow lines.

dashboard_pages.name: Camera Health
dashboard_pages.description: Grid of camera cards with green/amber/red status. Click -> last 24-h detection count chart.

dashboard_pages.name: Advanced Search
dashboard_pages.description: Area-based (draw polygon on map), route-based (pick two cameras), camera+time filter.

dashboard_pages.name: Reports / Review Queue
dashboard_pages.description: Low-confidence detections, impossible-travel flags, cloned-plate suspects. Approve / reject with audit log.

alert_types.trigger: New detection plate_hash found in watchlist table (Redis cache for speed).
Detection location ST_Within geofence polygon stored in DB.
Vehicle direction from AI engine conflicts with road_segment allowed direction.
Same plate at two cameras; calculated speed > configured threshold.
Same plate_hash in two locations within physically impossible time window.
Trajectory route_confidence below threshold; flagged for human review.
No heartbeat from camera_health table for > 5 minutes.

risk_score_formula: 0.40*B + 0.25*C + 0.20*R + 0.15*Q where B=blacklist match confidence, C=OCR confidence, R=route anomaly score, Q=evidence quality
excluded_scenarios: Full raw video streaming to central server

privacy_compliance.audit_logging: Immutable audit_logs table for every plate view, search, and alert action

scalability.prototype: Single GPU workstation or laptop with CUDA. 3-5 camera streams. Docker Compose. Local PostgreSQL.
scalability.pilot_50_cameras: Edge GPU nodes (NVIDIA Jetson/T4). Multi-partition Kafka. PG read replicas + Redis cluster. Nginx load balancer. MinIO cluster.
scalability.city_scale_1000_plus: Kubernetes HPA. Kafka partitioned by camera region. TimescaleDB hypertables. PostGIS spatial indexing. CDN-served frontend. Multi-zone DB with 7-day edge buffer.
